ACADEMIC.Name: Academic
ACADEMIC.Desc: Someone who relies on intellect. Often having social connections and surprising resources—often not their own. Can be an educator, researcher, teacher, inventor, or philanthropist.

DETECTIVE.Name: Detective
DETECTIVE.Desc: Private eyes, police detectives, journalists, and spies. They excel at gathering information through a combination of skepticism and open-mindedness.

DEFENDER.Name: Defender
DEFENDER.Desc: A bodyguard, bouncer, or anyone providing protection. Most often a police officer or a security guard.

THUG.Name: Thug
THUG.Desc: Some people enjoy hurting others. They are often disliked, which means they have to develop some instincts to help them ooze out of the trouble. Boxers, enforcers, hitmen, and various malicious crooks.

INGENUE.Name: Ingenue
INGENUE.Desc: Naive and simple. Anyone who believes in truth and virtue and strives for ultimate justice. Journalists with convictions, ministers, or political organizers.

FEMME_FATALE.Name: Femme Fatale
FEMME_FATALE.Desc: Someone who excels at manipulating others' emotions to exploit their weaknesses. Con artists and criminal geniuses.

Notifications.LimitReached: Limit reached: max 5 per stat or 7 per pair.
